مَرَاسِمُ Marks, stamps, impressions, signs, or characters. (KL.) ―
-b2- [And (assumed tropical:) Prescripts, commands, orders, biddings, or injunctions: and (assumed tropical:) assignments, or appointments: in both of these senses app. a contraction of مَرَاسِيمُ, pl. of ↓ مَرْسُومٌ ; thus used in the present day; like رُسُومٌ, pl. of ↓رَسْمٌ.] See 8.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
